headline: V26-3169: make the delivery workflow reliable

V26-3093.title: Keep a planned story's started flag through a rejected hand-off

criteria.text: A story seen started, handed off and rejected keeps trackerStarted; its return to backlog is reported, with no extra started change

V26-3099.title: End the queue's waitingOn by who set it, not by focusBy

criteria.text: The queue's waitingOn ends by who set it: a lane's --set /focus counts as speaking, and each listed case has a test

V26-2951.title: run-delivery characterization tests leave in-app serve processes running

criteria.text: A full suite run leaves no in-app serve process behind, and a killed app-check doesn't orphan its server

V26-3092.title: Merge-queue tests fail intermittently on a loaded machine

criteria.text: Each named merge-queue test is made deterministic with its cause stated, or its failure is shown outside the test and handled, under the plan's bounded flake runs

V26-3101.title: Stop run-tests.py losing a SIGTERM during discovery

criteria.text: A SIGTERM during discovery stops run-tests.py with the documented exit, with a test

V26-3102.title: Bring the older solution notes up to the store's format

criteria.text: The four older notes have the required sections, and the test checks sections and problem_type

V26-3094.title: Don't drop a candidate's new outputs when the merge queue resolves a regenerable conflict

criteria.text: A candidate's added or removed listed output is never silently dropped at sync or batch: it stops with source_conflict naming the path, per the plan's rows

V26-3064.title: Have the merge queue check the PR review before it merges

criteria.text: The queue's merge refuses a candidate whose PR review is missing or not current at the synced head, and a current review merges

V26-2986.title: Merge queue reports merge_refused after a successful github:pr-merge

criteria.text: The merge command's stderr reaches the runner's stop detail, scrubbed; Athena's side goes to a filed follow-up

V26-3108.title: Keep a lane's own word on the row the queue rests, so cleanup can't miss it

criteria.text: The queue keeps a resting row's own lane word, so cleanup waits for a lane at work with no pass between its word and the merge

V26-3095.title: Close the test gaps left at the review bound in the lane and lead commands

criteria.text: Each of the four lane and lead command paths has a test that fails when its guard is removed

V26-3103.title: Make capture-review say what it refused, and keep cards across a fixture commit

criteria.text: A capture-review refusal names the field and round, and the agreed carry-over keeps reviewed evidence across a judged commit

V26-3091.title: Tighten the recorded-pid solution note and test the pid -1 and pid 1 guard

criteria.text: The recorded-pid note states each case accurately, and a test proves the pid -1 and pid 1 guard without a real signal

V26-3109.title: Pin the line map's remaining closed-delivery behaviours with tests, and finish its wording

criteria.text: Each listed line-map mutation turns a test red, closed-delivery wording implies no work to come, a close stopped partway says so and names its command, and each possible flake is reproduced and fixed or explained

V26-3110.title: Forge adapters' merge --source should refuse a pull request that targets another base

criteria.text: Both forge adapters' merge --source refuses a PR retargeted away from --destination, naming its base, with the existing checks unchanged

V26-3068.title: Ship a ready-made candidate command for common forges

criteria.text: run-delivery ships a candidate command for feature/<key> branches on GitHub and Bitbucket, and the guide's worked adopter uses it

V26-3089.title: Wake the lead when a check fails, not when the base rerun ends

criteria.text: A failed check journals an entry before any base rerun, wait wakes on it, the rerun's start and verdict are journaled, and the views show the waiting stage

V26-3005.title: orchestrate-work: in-flight planned work carries its run id before hand-off

criteria.text: A planned story shows its run's review rounds in the line map before hand-off, with ownership enforced

V26-2807.title: Give each merge check a readable name the live view can show

criteria.text: Checks carry an optional readable title through the provider contract, record, runner and generic renderer, falling back to the id; Athena's side goes to a filed follow-up

V26-3085.title: Keep the two round briefs from drifting apart

criteria.text: Removing a shared sentence from either round brief fails a test

V26-3104.title: Close the review round gaps a run-delivery rehearsal found

criteria.text: The round brief states resolvedFindings holds only open findings, and the other two items have a decision and any fix

V26-3087.title: Give a lens one checkout per delivery instead of one per round

criteria.text: A lens keeps one checkout across a delivery's rounds, holding exactly each round's candidate, re-prepared when a dependency changed

V26-3074.title: Have plan-review write a validated review record

criteria.text: plan-review writes a validated review record from its store when the lenses align or on end

V26-3100.title: Keep the suite's temp churn from creeping back

criteria.text: The generation extraction is cut, or cached only as the plan allows, and the no-guard decision is recorded on the ticket

V26-3065.title: Serve the lead's integration build under the in-app lease

criteria.text: The lead can serve a build under the in-app lease, or app-check names the process holding the port and how to release it

V26-3066.title: Record the evidence page's per-story notes in the record

criteria.text: lead-evidence records the per-story notes, so republishing after a compaction loses nothing

V26-3067.title: Make ship's tooling strip robust to later tooling changes and merged bases

criteria.text: ship builds the product-only branch correctly in all three listed cases

V26-3069.title: Warn early when a lane's work needs a file another lane owns

criteria.text: doctor --delivery or lead-assign reports a story whose plan section names files outside its lane's ownership, before the lane starts

V26-3073.title: Small setup fixes: build without a story key, tracker validation without AGENTS.md

criteria.text: build accepts no key for the integration build, and the tracker-properties validator runs without AGENTS.md

V26-3088.title: Prove the merge queue's candidate step at setup, and show why it failed

criteria.text: A candidate step's failure shows its exit code and stderr; a binding without {candidate} is refused; doctor and serve catch a missing candidate program

V26-3107.title: Have the lead review their own integration changes before merging to the default branch

criteria.text: The close-out names the lead's integration review as its own step before merging to the default branch, guarded by a pin

V26-3105.title: Prove this repository's own delivery path on its first real run

criteria.text: This delivery's real ready, merge, tracker snapshot, forge snapshot and online doctor results are recorded on the ticket, and both small gaps are fixed or declined

V26-3171.title: Check only the timed-out group's own pids in run-delivery's timeout test

criteria.text: The timeout test asserts on the pids of the group it started, passes with an unrelated sleep 30 alive, and still fails when the timed-out group's own process survives

V26-3181.title: Find why a SupervisorPostureTests case failed once in a loaded full run

criteria.text: Two archives of one delivery in the same second no longer collide, and the supervisor posture test passes with two closes inside one second

V26-3191.title: Retry run-delivery's lead writes when the record moved under them

criteria.text: run-delivery's lead commands re-read and recompute on version_stale, a bounded number of times, and a forced write between read and patch no longer fails them

V26-3178.title: Refuse a hand-off whose --run another subject already holds

criteria.text: handoff --run refuses with run_bound when another planned or queued subject holds that run, and the bound subject's own hand-off still works

finish.label: Every story
finish.text: Each story merged to delivery/workflow-reliability through the merge queue, or removed with its recorded reason where the plan allows

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 and Node 22 at the head of the integration change request into main, where base.ref is back to main

finish.label: Integration CI
finish.text: CI's Ubuntu job passes on a draft change request from delivery/workflow-reliability to main, with the run linked; main itself waits for the operator's word to integrate

finish.label: Deferrals
finish.text: Every deferral has an open follow-up item, filed under the epic

approvals.text: `LINEAR_API_KEY` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` exported in the lead's shell, for the views' snapshots throughout and V26-3105's online `doctor`.
Filing the follow-ups: Athena's side of V26-2986 and V26-2807, this repository adopting V26-3094's key, and any the Bounded flake work decision produces.
Any tag. The record-shape tickets (V26-3093, V26-3099, V26-3108, V26-3005, V26-3089, V26-2807, V26-3109) mean the next release goes out first as a candidate, applied in one adopter.

outOfScope: The release and lifecycle tickets (V26-2803, V26-2804, V26-2805, V26-3096, V26-3097, V26-3098), which come next as their own delivery.
Athena's side of V26-2986 and V26-2807: the `github:pr-merge` helper, titles from `harness:plan`, and V26-2807's proof-merge record, which this binding can't produce because its provider is null.
Cutting a release, which waits for the operator's word.
Integrating delivery/workflow-reliability into main, which waits for the operator's word; by the operator's ruling this delivery lands on its own integration branch, not straight to main.

outcome.summary: The delivery workflow keeps its record true and tells the lead what happened when it happens.
outcome.text: Thirty-three backlog tickets land on delivery/workflow-reliability: the state document and merge queue keep their facts true across hand-offs and conflicts, the lead hears of failures when they happen, run-delivery's lane and lead commands and round briefs close the gaps rehearsals found, the suite stops flaking and churning, and this repository's own delivery path is proven on a real run.
